name: Northland Auto & Truck Accessories
old_description: Northland Automotive is a full-service accessories shop located in Billings Montana. We are a family owned and operated business that has been around for over 40 years. We have a very knowledgeable staff that have well over 150 years of combined industry experience. We have 4 full time shop technicians that install everything we sell. We offer a very wide variety of products from the top manufactures in the industry. We have over 100 manufactures that we can choose from, and we only sell the best rated products available. Northland Automotive has over a 15,000 sq ft. warehouse with a complete inventory of products in stock. We realize we can't stock every product, so we have agreements with other vendors and warehouses that we can pull product & parts from in order to service our customers in a timely manner.
about:
Northland Auto & Truck Accessories operates from Billings, Montana, where it has served the region for over 40 years as a family-owned and operated business. The company was founded by the current ownership group, though specific founders are not named in public records.

The shop stocks and installs a broad range of aftermarket accessories for pickup trucks and SUVs, drawing on relationships with more than 100 manufacturers. Its 15,000-square-foot warehouse carries a deep inventory of parts ranging from air intakes and lighting to bed covers, bumpers, and winches. Four full-time technicians handle installation of every product sold, including spray-in bedliners, truck toppers, running boards, and grille guards. The staff collectively holds over 150 years of industry experience.

Northland primarily serves individual truck and SUV owners in Montana and surrounding areas, as well as commercial fleets needing upfit solutions. Customers include recreational off-road enthusiasts seeking suspension lifts and lighting from brands like Rigid Industries and Baja Designs, contractors requiring fiberglass or work-style truck toppers, and drivers needing animal-strike protection with full front bumpers and grille guards from Ranch Hand and Go Rhino.

The company emphasizes adherence to every manufacturer’s warranty and installation guidelines, and it supplements its own stock with vendor agreements to source hard-to-find parts quickly. Its guiding principle, captured in the slogan “Sell Everything But The Truck!,” reflects a commitment to being a one-stop shop for truck and SUV accessories backed by professional installation.
